Context: 7. Advance payment to supplier

- (ii) turnkey contracts etc.  
Such advance payments should not exceed the following limits:  
- (a)
- Thirty per cent of the contract value to private firms;
- Forty per cent of the contract value to a State or Central Government
- (b) agency or a Public Sector Undertaking; or
- (c) in case of maintenance contract, the amount should not exceed the amount payable for six months under the contract.
